candidate_claims.text: From June to July, the focus idea evolved from relying solely on physical phone separation (June 10 plan) to addressing "starting friction" — the delay in beginning work — after observing that hiding the phone did not eliminate time lost in decision-making (July 4 correction). The new approach, decided on July 18, was to pre-write a concrete next action on a card before each work block, silence notifications for 30 minutes, and log the time from sitting down to starting the action. This is a planned experiment, not yet completed.
